name: codex-council
description: Token-aware Codex Council review plus Codex Forge creative proposal generation with bounded multi-agent synthesis.

interface.shortDescription: Run token-aware multi-agent deliberation inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: Codex Council adapts council-style review to Codex-only workflows: six historically named council roles, bounded local role tuning, compact skill-review mode, typed synthesis templates, separate Chairman synthesis, pre-session estimates, expanded-mode confirmation, local learning history, performance analysis, optional frontend UX critique, Bob browser evidence, anonymized review, rubric scoring, dissent capture, ASCII banner, compact invocation logging, path-only raw bundles, pre/post stats, and Codex Forge for bounded creative proposal generation.

Run a council review on my implementation plan.
Use Codex Council to review this diff for blockers.
Run a frontend council review with Leonardo and Bob.
Tune Ada's Codex Council alter with a compact role behavior preview.
